title: Elevator Service Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Elevator Service: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Elevator Service Inspection Checklist covers elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing. The building elevator coordinator records Elevator Service criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Elevator Service Inspection Checklist keeps Elevator Service exceptions visible until the building elevator coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Elevator Service Inspection Checklist at machine space, hoistway access point, car, and affected landings. Document elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing identity before Elevator Service begins. Compare elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing findings with stated Elevator Service criteria; route unresolved Elevator Service issues to licensed or otherwise qualified elevator service reviewer. For Elevator Service Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Elevator Service. Ask licensed or otherwise qualified elevator service reviewer to review Elevator Service conditions beyond the building elevator coordinator's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Elevator Service, identify responsible parties, machine space, hoistway access point, car, and affected landings, and the linked elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing source.

fields.label: Service call, permit, and maintenance-control reference

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Elevator Service facts for elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Elevator Service inspection checks
items: Leveling, ride, noise, and vibration observation
Alarm, emergency communication, and lighting response
Visible controls, indicators, and operating fixtures
Machine-space housekeeping and accessible component condition

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: Before closing Elevator Service, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Building Elevator Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Work or testing beyond technician qualification
Test and measurement record within authorized scope
blocks.guidance: Pause Elevator Service when the unit cannot be secured, a life-safety device fails, or required qualified elevator review is unavailable. Retain the available Elevator Service proof and route unresolved elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing scope to building elevator coordinator.
